explanation: This test case only attempts to verify that the FX rate is locked at the moment of top-up initiation (fx_lock). It does not cover the transactional ordering of credit before debit (credit_before_debit), the rollback behavior on timeout (timeout_rollback), or the dual approval requirement for large top-ups (dual_approval). The test only checks that the FX rate shown matches the rate at initiation, but does not verify that the rate remains locked throughout the transaction or that the transaction completes correctly. It also does not verify that the funding source is debited only after the wallet is credited, nor does it simulate a timeout or test the approval workflow for large amounts.
missingAssertions: Verify that the funding source is debited only after the destination wallet is credited
Verify that if the payment provider callback times out after 5 seconds, the transaction is rolled back and neither side is affected
Verify that top-ups above SGD 10,000 require approval from a second business owner before settlement
hypothesizedBugThisWouldMiss: A bug where the funding source is debited before the destination wallet is credited would not be caught, since the test does not verify transactional ordering. Also, a bug where the transaction is not rolled back on provider callback timeout would not be detected, as no timeout scenario is tested. Finally, a bug where top-ups above SGD 10,000 do not require or enforce second-owner approval would be missed.

suggestedReplacement.description: Verify full top-up transaction behavior including FX rate lock, credit-before-debit ordering, timeout rollback, and dual approval for large amounts
steps: Initiate top-up of USD 100 and record FX rate at initiation
Verify FX rate used matches recorded rate
Verify destination wallet is credited before funding source is debited
Simulate payment provider callback timeout after 5 seconds and verify transaction rollback with no changes to wallet or funding source
Verify that second business owner approval is required before settlement
Approve top-up with second owner and verify settlement completes successfully
suggestedReplacement.expectedResult: FX rate is locked at initiation; destination wallet is credited before funding source is debited; transaction rolls back on provider callback timeout with no side effects; top-ups above SGD 10,000 require second-owner approval before settlement
